page.overview:
Who is Jeremiah Noble?

Jeremiah Noble, also known as Jeremy, is a Brujah antitribu and the protector of The Ravens, a politically motivated coven in the Sabbat.

Jeremiah was not even old enough to read when his parents moved west on the Oklahoma trail. He grew up helping his father raise sheep, but the lifestyle never caught his interest.

After turning 18, he stole his father's best horse and $20, and headed south to find his fortune. By the time he was 20, he was a passable horse thief.

When Jeremy was eventually run out of Arizona by friends who hated to see him hanged, he turned to bank and train robbery instead. He soon became infamous in the outlaw circuit.
